authorization: User approved metadata-only inventories for the 22 queued URLs, retaining every capture timestamp.
date_windows: Use each target's proposed_window_start and proposed_window_end from the approved queue, inclusive.
interpretation: Retain every returned CDX row, including repeated digests and duplicate index rows. CDX URL canonicalization may return scheme or www variants; preserve the returned original URL. This is not a host-wide or all-time inventory.
estimate: At least one metadata request per target, with additional pages and retries as needed. Capture counts are unknown; the byte and request ceilings bound this run rather than guarantee completion.
storage: Raw metadata and the ledger remain on the droplet's attached volume. Copy only compact summaries to the Mac.
